name: Ban'ethil Hollow
summary: Ban'ethil Hollow is a rugged ravine cutting into the woodland just south of the main road connecting Dolanaar and Darnassus. It has become a dangerous haven for corrupted, aggressive furbolgs who pose a constant threat to travelers. Tucked away in the back of the ravine lies the entrance to the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

sections.title: A Perilous Ravine
sections.body: Situated off the highway between Dolanaar and Darnassus, Ban'ethil Hollow is a sharp reminder that the boughs of Teldrassil are not entirely safe. Furbolgs driven mad by the strange affliction plaguing the World Tree have taken refuge throughout the rocky descent. They frequently stalk the nearby path, waiting to ambush unwary couriers and wandering sentinels. Deep within the ravine sits the threshold of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den, where slumbering druids and ancient tunnels face encroachment from the maddened beasts outside.

faq.answer: Ban'ethil Hollow is a ravine in central Teldrassil, located just south of the primary road running between the village of Dolanaar and the capital city of Darnassus.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here hostile?
faq.answer: The furbolgs across Teldrassil have succumbed to a spreading corruption and madness that grips the World Tree's wildlife. Instead of living peacefully alongside the night elves as they historically have, these tribes have become fiercely territorial and violent.

faq.q: What is inside the Ban'ethil Barrow Den at the back of the hollow?
aliases: what is in the barrow den
faq.answer: The Ban'ethil Barrow Den is an underground complex historically used by night elven druids to enter deep hibernation and commune with the Emerald Dream. However, with corruption rising in the hollow, the den has become dangerous ground.

faq.q: Is the road above the hollow safe to travel?
faq.answer: The main road is generally patrolled by night elf sentinels, but furbolgs from Ban'ethil Hollow often venture up from the ravine to ambush travelers. Travelers making the journey between Dolanaar and Darnassus should remain on their guard.

angles.text: Seeing the furbolgs fall to madness so close to the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus is a grim sign of Teldrassil's mounting sickness, requiring young sentinels and druids to step in.
The hollow conceals the entrance to Ban'ethil Barrow Den, sacred ground where druids traditionally rest to commune with the Emerald Dream, now endangered by rabid wildlife.
